q1: How much badminton have you played on a proper court (garden, beach or holiday games don't count)?
q1a: None yet, only a handful of times, or only in school PE.
q1b: Less than a year, or only now and then.
q1c: 1 to 2 years, about once a week or more.
q1d: More than 2 years of regular play, now or in the past.
q2: Have you played squash, tennis, table tennis, padel or another racket sport?
q2b: Yes, casually or a long time ago.
q2c: Yes, regularly for a year or more.
q2d: Yes — squash or tennis in leagues, club teams or tournaments.
q3: Hitting from the back of the court (overhead clears) — which is closest to you?
q3a: I often miss the shuttle overhead, or my clears land in the middle of the court or in the net.
q3b: My forehand clear gets over the net but usually lands short of the back; on my backhand side I can only scoop it up underarm.
q3c: My forehand clear reaches the back of the court in most rallies; from deep on my backhand side I get the shuttle back, but only to mid-court.
q3d: I clear to the back from both rear corners (backhand or round-the-head) and can choose between a high defensive clear and a flat attacking one.
q4: Smashes and drop shots — which is closest to you?
q4a: I don't smash or play drop shots yet, and I usually miss a shuttle hit hard at me.
q4b: I can smash a short, high shuttle from mid-court, but often into the net or out; hard smashes at me usually win the point.
q4c: I smash and play drop shots from the back of the court, though my drops sometimes float; I return many smashes, mostly by lifting them high.
q4d: I choose between a steep smash and a fast drop depending on where my opponents stand, and I return most smashes with a block to the net or a drive.
q5: Serving and play at the net — what can you do reliably?
q5a: My serve often goes into the net or out, and I rarely reach shuttles that drop close to the net.
q5b: I get most serves in, but my low serve often floats; at the net I can lift the shuttle back, but my net shots often rise or hit the tape.
q5c: My low serve is reliable enough for doubles, my net shots usually drop close to the tape, and I hit down shuttles that come above the net.
q5d: My net shots are tight enough to force opponents to lift, and I take the shuttle early at the net and kill loose replies; my low serve is rarely attacked.
q6: Which games do you usually play, and how do they go?
q6a: Mostly lessons, coaching or knocking up — I rarely play scored games.
q6b: Social games with beginners and improvers.
q6c: Regular club nights with intermediate players; I win about half my games.
q6d: League, club team or tournament matches; I usually beat intermediate club players.
